arguments.sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, customer_id
    FROM main.olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
),
delivered_items AS (
    SELECT i.*
    FROM main.olist_order_items AS i
    JOIN delivered_orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
),
five_star_reviews AS (
    SELECT r.order_id, r.review_id
    FROM main.olist_order_reviews AS r
    JOIN delivered_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.review_score = 5
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered_orders) AS delivered_orders,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM delivered_orders) AS distinct_delivered_order_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM main.olist_customers) AS nonunique_or_null_customer_keys,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered_items) AS delivered_items,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered_items AS i
     JOIN delivered_orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
     JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id) AS items_joined_to_customers,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered_items
     WHERE price IS NULL OR freight_value IS NULL OR seller_id IS NULL) AS items_with_missing_fields,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered_items
     WHERE price <> ROUND(price, 2) OR freight_value <> ROUND(freight_value, 2)) AS items_with_fractional_cents,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM five_star_reviews) AS five_star_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT review_id) FROM five_star_reviews) AS distinct_five_star_review_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, review_id FROM five_star_reviews)) AS distinct_five_star_order_review_pairs,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM five_star_reviews) AS five_star_orders

arguments.sql:
WITH seller_orders AS (
    SELECT i.seller_id,
           o.order_id,
           o.customer_id,
           SUM(i.price - i.freight_value) AS order_profit
    FROM main.olist_orders AS o
    JOIN main.olist_order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY i.seller_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id
),
five_star_reviews AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS rating_count
    FROM main.olist_order_reviews
    WHERE review_score = 5
    GROUP BY order_id
),
seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT so.seller_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customer_count,
           ROUND(SUM(so.order_profit), 2) AS profit,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           SUM(COALESCE(r.rating_count, 0)) AS five_star_count
    FROM seller_orders AS so
    LEFT JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = so.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN five_star_reviews AS r ON r.order_id = so.order_id
    GROUP BY so.seller_id
),
achievements AS (
    SELECT 1 AS category_order, 'Most distinct customer unique IDs' AS achievement,
           seller_id, customer_count AS value
    FROM seller_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Highest total profit', seller_id, profit
    FROM seller_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Most distinct orders', seller_id, order_count
    FROM seller_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Most 5-star ratings', seller_id, five_star_count
    FROM seller_metrics
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category_order, achievement, seller_id, value,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY category_order
               ORDER BY value DESC, seller_id
           ) AS position
    FROM achievements
)
SELECT achievement, seller_id, value
FROM ranked
WHERE position = 1
ORDER BY category_order
LIMIT 4
